metadata.description:
From Fold to Materials, version 1.3.0, reports the complete dated Materials Science reconstruction of Smithian Fold Theory V3: 289 of 289 registered obligations admitted through the untouched engine, while remaining open to lawful extension.

The branch contains 73,984 exact candidates and decisions, 289 unique survivors, 1,156 passing adverse controls, 289 implementation-distinct reconstructions and 289 receipt-bound empirical packages. Every claim reaches the single premise-free foundational theorem. No axiom, free or fitted parameter, imported constitutive law, target-selected survivor, numerical-zero ontology, negative proof quantity, irrational or imaginary proof value or floating proof arithmetic is admitted.

The complete-field extension covers quantitative crystallography and diffraction; defects and multiscale microstructure; transformations and metastability; fracture, fatigue, creep, tribology and rheology; thermal, electronic, ionic, magnetic, superconducting, optical and photonic response; material classes; soft, biological, nano and surface materials; degradation; processing; computational materials; extreme conditions; sustainability; complete empirical vectors; and one-owner cross-branch handoffs.

The 271-claim empirical Grand Lock preserves 1,040 evidence lines and 334 source-identity occurrences. The terminal owner graph proves all 1,681 predecessor claims root-reachable across 28,437 dependency edges. The release includes the exhaustive paper in PDF and Markdown plus its evidence and source package. Maria Smith's authorship, the Ernos Labs open-science mission and the distinction between open criticism and engine admission are integral to the technical paper.

metadata.title: From Fold to Materials: A Complete Exact, Parameter-Free and Machine-Closed Reconstruction of Materials Science
